moment.nslocationwheninuseusagedescripti.zh-Hans: 在活动中打卡时记录手表当前位置、海拔和地址。
moment.nslocationwheninuseusagedescripti.en: Linko Moment uses your location to record exercise routes and activity check-ins when you choose to use these features.

moment.nshealthshareusagedescription.zh-Hans: 读取您授权的心率、活动能量、步数、距离和手表体能训练，用于显示本次运动数据。
moment.nshealthshareusagedescription.en: Read the heart rate, active energy, steps, distance and Watch workouts you authorize to display your exercise data.

moment.nshealthupdateusagedescription.zh-Hans: 将您主动记录的手表运动保存到 Apple 健康，用于在手机和手表查看运动记录。
moment.nshealthupdateusagedescription.en: Save workouts you record on Apple Watch to Apple Health so you can view them on your phone and watch.
